condor_os.description: Operating system to use as default for Condor jobs (e.g., LINUX). Leave empty to use machine's OS.

condor_arch.description: Architecture to use as default for Condor jobs (e.g., X86_64). Leave empty to use machine's architecture.

condor_submit.description: Full path to the condor_submit executable.

condor_rm.description: Full path to the condor_rm executable.

condor_config.description: Value for CONDOR_CONFIG environment variable, used to locate Condor configuration files.

check_vanilla_files.description: Whether to perform file existence/permission checks for vanilla universe jobs. Set to 'yes' or 'no'.

condor_mpi_script.description: Path to MPI script for Condor parallel jobs, or 'no' to disable.
